prompts.initial:
Edit the supplied current PNPLINE FAQ website section into ONE complete standalone horizontal 4:3 section image at 1448×1086. Expand it from 6 FAQs to exactly 8 FAQs and replace every old question and answer with the exact v3 content below.

DESIGN:
- Preserve the current PNPLINE visual world: pristine pale ice-blue background, deep navy Chinese sans typography, PNPLINE blue #00ABE1, CTA/link blue #007FA8, cool-gray hairlines.
- Keep the eyebrow 常见问题 and H2 咨询前，您可能想先了解.
- Use a spacious two-column FAQ layout with four items per column.
- Do not use eight bulky cards. Use clean editorial accordion rows separated by fine horizontal rules, with generous vertical rhythm.
- Each item must show: blue number, question, full answer, and related text links where specified.
- Make question text medium-weight, answers smaller regular cool-gray/navy, related links compact and blue with arrows.
- Use smaller text and increased line-height so all 8 full answers remain readable without feeling crowded.
- The first FAQ may receive a very subtle pale-blue active background or minus indicator. Keep all eight answers visibly readable in this static design so content can be reviewed.
- Use minus/plus indicators sparingly and consistently. Do not imply unrelated functionality.
- No images, icons, logos, gradients, shadows, glass effects, decorative statistics, or invented copy.
- Remove the old bottom line "还有其他问题？提交您的需求 ↗".
- Do not show raw URLs in the visual design; show the human-readable link labels below.
- Increase the canvas height as needed within 4:3; do not crop any answer or link.

EXACT FAQ CONTENT:

01
Q: 获取报价前，需要准备哪些信息？
A: 请准备商品类目、发货方式、预计月货量、目的地与IOR需求，并留下可联系的方式。尚未明确的事项可以标注，便于后续进一步确认。
Links: none

02
Q: 货量尚未确定，可以先咨询吗？
A: 可以先说明商品类型、销售计划和预计发货节奏。暂未确定的项目可选择“未定”或“不清楚”，具体受理条件和费用需进一步确认。
Links: none

03
Q: 一件代发与FBA中转补货如何选择？
A: 一件代发面向从美国仓库逐单发往买家的订单；FBA中转补货面向先入中转仓，再按计划发往亚马逊仓库的货物。混合运营时，可分别说明两类需求。
Links: 了解一件代发 ↗   了解FBA中转补货 ↗

04
Q: 可以把中国发货、美国清关和海外仓入库一起咨询吗？
A: 可以围绕中国出货、头程运输、美国清关、仓储与尾程配送提交需求。具体承接的环节、路线与各方责任，需要在方案确认时明确。
Links: 了解头程运输 ↗   了解IOR服务 ↗

05
Q: 报价是否包含清关、税费和其他附加费用？
A: 是否包含应以具体报价清单为准。请重点核对清关与合规相关费用、适用税费、最低收费、长期仓储和特殊操作等项目，并确认费用的发生条件。
Links: 查看费用与报价 ↗

06
Q: 不清楚是否需要IOR服务，怎么办？
A: 可选择“不清楚”，并提供商品与交易的基本情况，以便进一步确认服务需求和责任范围。网站说明不能代替对具体货物和交易的核实。
Links: 了解IOR服务 ↗

07
Q: 美国仓库是自营的吗？如何了解实际作业情况？
A: 是的，PNPLINE直接运营美国仓库。可通过仓库资料了解经确认的场地、照片与作业范围。未公开或与您的货物有关的条件，可在咨询时提出。
Links: 提交咨询 ↗

08
Q: 如何查询库存与出库进度？
A: 可先了解WMS的库存、订单与出库相关功能。实际可用功能、账号权限、数据更新方式及系统对接范围，需要结合使用方案确认。
Links: 了解WMS功能 ↗   查看API对接 ↗

Ensure every Chinese character and all eight numbers are exact and legible. Output only the complete redesigned FAQ section image.
